archimate:CourseOfAction.name: 1. end to end pipeline
archimate:CourseOfAction.documentation:
A connected, end-to-end delivery pipeline​.
Replacing disjointed ways of working with one connected process, so people spend less time on manual workarounds from first opportunity through to delivery.​
Priority for pre-Christmas design work, given the importance of an efficient ‘operational spine’ has on operational delivery teams. Requirements and new ways of working will need to be developed to support tech-related activity in February / March 2027. ​
Level 2 capabilities are: Strategic prioritisation and triage​ Portfolio, programme and project management ​ Pipeline development ​ Operations oversight​ Operational risk management ​ Governance​ Corporate performance monitoring​
